Name: Joja Luck Market
Author: Dominikkovi
Description:
[center][size=4]Joja Luck Market adds a new way to trade items at the JojaMart counter! Do you have extra crops or resources that you don't need? Now you can trade them for rare and valuable items. This mod adds a special feature to JojaMart called "Try Your Luck." You choose a stack of matching items, pick a reward from the daily list, and see your chance to get it. The chance depends on the total value of the items you offer. But be careful: JojaMart keeps your items even if you don't get the reward![/size][/center]
[heading][left]How Does It Work?[/left]
[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Talk to the JojaMart clerk and open press "J"(you can change this button)[/*]
[*]Look at today's list of rewards. This list changes every day.[/*]
[*]Pick the reward you want.[/*]
[*]Put items from your inventory into the offer slots.[/*]
[*]Check your chance, shown next to a spinning wheel.[/*]
[*]Press "Spin" and see if you get the reward![/*]
[/list][youtube]M3lsNKBJ58M[/youtube]
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Joja Counter Integration[/b]: A new "Try Your Luck" option appears right inside the JojaMart shop. You can open the market with the configurable button.[/*]
[*][b]Daily Item Pool[/b]: Every day, JojaMart shows a new, random list of rewards you can try to get.[/*]
[*][b]Fair Value Calculation[/b]: Your chance depends on the total value of the items you offer, compared to the value of the reward.[/*]
[*][b]Quality Bonuses[/b]: Items with higher quality (Silver, Gold, Iridium) give extra points. High-quality items help you more.[/*]
[*][b]Daily Luck Factor[/b]: Your daily luck (from the game) has a small effect on your final chance. On lucky days, you get a small bonus.[/*]
[*][b]Multiple Offer Slots[/b]: You can offer more than one type of item at the same time to build up your total value.[/*]
[*][b]Reroll Option[/b]: Don't like today's list? Pay gold to get a new list of rewards.[/*]
[*][b]Risk & Reward[/b]: This is the most important rule: your offered items are always used up, whether you get the reward or not. Think carefully before you try![/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] (Stardew Modding API)[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (Recommended): With this, you can change settings inside the game, such as how many times you can try each day, how many rewards appear, and how strong the luck bonus is.[/*]
[/list][heading]Shout Outs[/heading]
Special thanks to the Minecraft mod "Upgrade Your Items" for the original idea behind this item-trading concept!

Manifest.Name: Joja Luck Market
Manifest.Description: Adds a 'Try Your Luck' gambling minigame at the JojaMart counter. Wager a stack of items for a chance to win a rarer target item, with odds influenced by your Daily Luck.
